lead: A `[limits]` reader answers off `Snapshot::table`, not the typed `Config` beside it.
body: `Ctx::configured_memory_limit` reads `self.base.table` through `Request::get`, so `Snapshot { config: Config { limits: Some(..), .. }, .. }` reports no ceiling. Build both halves from one TOML string (`parse::<toml::Table>()`, then `table.clone().try_into()`) as `crates/nvs-runtime/tests/configured_limits.rs` does.
